tagline: Mobile apps and games, built with care.
description: Mahulenok is an independent software studio registered in Kazakhstan as IE Ivan Baikov. We design, develop and publish mobile applications and games for Android and iOS.
about: Mahulenok is the brand of IE Ivan Baikov, a sole proprietorship (individual entrepreneur) registered in the Republic of Kazakhstan. We design, develop and publish mobile applications and games for Android and iOS, together with the backend services that power them.

We care about the details: fast and lightweight apps, honest monetisation and respect for our users' privacy. Every product is built and maintained in-house, from the first prototype to long-term support after release.
Our applications are distributed through Google Play under the developer name Mahulenok and are published by IE Ivan Baikov.
